sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 5:28

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 5:28:1
items.html: The completion of their work was afterward, now that the lights returned to descend a second descent: For then the externality of their vessel was completed, and the lights were also diminished there permanently, since only the light of Hochma came to the vessel of Keter, and the light of Bina to the vessel of Hochma, and so forth; and by this the aspect of their vessels was completed.
